normal_orientation_method: Closed solids run bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals; facade panels are wound explicitly. Reimported loop normals must be finite and unit length, and 22,500 deterministic visibility rays toward nine interior targets must never meet a flipped first face.
_shipped_file_note: This record validates the PRE-OPTIMIZE asset, which is what stage 3 approved and what artifacts/.../optimize/input/ archives. The shipping letterman-digital-arts-center.glb is the stage-4 output: identical geometry, meshopt-compressed and joined per material (197 objects -> 14, 215 primitives -> 20, 1,032,424 -> 166,464 bytes). Triangle count, dimensions, bbox, origin and the material-name set are unchanged and re-verified in optimize/validation.json.
